title.zh: SmartLingo V2 第一轮：免费真实场景闯关
title.en: SmartLingo V2 round one: free real-life missions

purpose.zh: 将 Play 改为先选学习语言、再完成可用的真实生活任务；复用已有生活口语数据，为问答增加有明确目标的三选一回复挑战。
purpose.en: Make Play language-first and lead into practical real-life missions; reuse authored Everyday Speaking content to add goal-based three-choice reply challenges.

zh: Play 顶部先展示 12 种学习语言选择，并突出咖啡店、食品店和车站三个免费初级任务；保留原有六个活动入口和全部 12 个生活场景。
生活口语在工作人员提问后，让学习者听、看提示、从三句目标语言回答中选择；即时反馈并允许重试，跟读仍默认关闭。
问答进度显示已完成及首次答对组数；V2 规划文档明确区分免费闯关、未来 AI 同伴和待验证的 Max 一对一导师。
仅查看中高级课程详情不再消耗 7 天 Max 试用；用户明确点击开始试用后才通过原有课程加入接口开通，界面说明无自动续费。
en: Play now places the twelve-language picker first and highlights three free beginner missions at a café, grocery store, and station while preserving six other activities and all twelve scenes.

After a staff prompt, Everyday Speaking asks the learner to listen, read a meaning cue, and choose among three target-language replies, with immediate retry feedback; microphone repetition remains off by default.
Exchange progress distinguishes completed and first-try answers. The V2 plan clearly separates shipped free practice from future AI companions and an unverified Max one-to-one tutor.

Viewing an Intermediate or Advanced course detail no longer consumes the seven-day Max trial. Only an explicit Start Trial action uses the existing enrollment endpoint, with non-renewal stated clearly.

zh: Play、生活口语初级/中级/高级场景、中高级课程详情的试用入口及 V2 产品规划；不改变 Free/Max 价格、支付或数据库。
en: Play, all Everyday Speaking scene levels, the trial entry on Intermediate and Advanced course details, and the V2 product plan; no change to Free/Max prices, payments, or database.

zh: 语言选择从活动入口下方移至前面，场景任务链接仅在选定学习语言后直达该语言的初级场景。
选项由同一场景已编写的一问一答组成，不临时生成难度失控的句子；每组提供一个正确答案和两个不同干扰项。
完成统计按问答组去重，返回上一题不会重复增加成绩。
课程详情 GET 改为仅读取有效 Max 权益与试用资格；POST 加入中高级课程仍按现有规则原子启动一次性试用。
en: The language picker moves ahead of activities; mission links enter a beginner scene in the selected language only after language selection.
Choices reuse authored question-answer pairs from the same scene instead of generating unexpectedly difficult sentences; each has one answer and two distinct distractors.
Completion is deduplicated by dialogue pair so revisiting an exchange cannot inflate results.
Course detail GET now only reads active Max access and trial eligibility; the existing Intermediate or Advanced course enrollment POST remains the explicit one-time trial action.

zh: TypeScript、改动文件零警告 lint、完整 435 项测试与生产构建通过；新增测试核对 12 种语言 × 12 个场景 × 3 个等级的 4,320 组问答。
发布后需在真实浏览器验证匿名用户选语言、进入场景、选择回复、手机/iPad/桌面宽度及退出流程。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint on changed files, all 435 tests, and the production build pass; a new test checks 4,320 exchanges across twelve languages, twelve scenes, and three levels.
After deployment, verify anonymous language selection, scene entry, reply choice, responsive widths, and exit in a real browser.

zh: AI 同伴、Max 一对一实时导师、独立学习迁移测评与新进度记忆不属于本轮已上线功能；将在后续轮次实施和验证。
en: AI companions, the Max live one-to-one tutor, independent transfer assessment, and new progress memory are not shipped in this round; they require later implementation and validation.

zh: 直接复用 SmartLingo 现有 12 场景、各 10 组编写好的对话和图像媒体；保持免费初级及现有七天 Max 试用规则。
en: Reuse twelve existing SmartLingo scenes, ten authored exchanges per scene, and media assets; retain free beginner access and the existing seven-day Max trial rules.

rollback.zh: 回退到上一成功 Cloudflare Worker 可恢复旧 Play 顺序与生活口语播放器；不删除学习数据。
rollback.en: Roll back to the previous successful Cloudflare Worker to restore the prior Play order and Everyday Speaking player; no learning data is deleted.
